title: 【Encouraged to participate 鼓勵參加】2025淨零排放科技國際競賽 2025 Net Zero Tech International Contest @ Taiwan
content:
分類： 活動公告
來源： 永續發展中心 - 李莉莉 Li-Li Lee - sd@gms.ndhu.edu.tw - 電話03-890-5920

標題： 【Encouraged to participate 鼓勵參加】2025淨零排放科技國際競賽 2025 Net Zero Tech International Contest @ Taiwan 
日期： Fri, 21 Mar 2025 08:30:53 +0800
附檔： 2025 Net Zero Tech 淨零排放科技國際競賽EDM_中英文合併版_20250225.jpg (6 MB)   
大家好，

由臺灣永續治理大學聯盟協辦「2025 淨零排放科技國際競賽」熱烈開跑，總獎金高達 650 萬，分為主競（國內）賽與國際賽進行，竭誠邀請海內外，在「淨零排放科技」研究成果卓越的大學師生組隊參賽。

競賽詳情請閱  
https://sustainable.ntu.edu.tw/news/677649007f6fd/detail

Dear all,

The Taiwan Sustainable Governance University Alliance is co-organizing the 2025 Net Zero Tech International Contest @ Taiwan, inviting innovative teams worldwide to shape a sustainable future! The competition focuses on breakthroughs in net-zero technologies, seeking solutions for carbon reduction, energy transition, and sustainability.

The 2025 Net-Zero Emission Technology International Competition consists of a domestic main competition and an international competition, with a total prize pool of NT$6.5 million. Interested teams are encouraged to register by June 25, 2025.

Please go the link below for more details.
https://sustainable.ntu.edu.tw/news/677649007f6fd/detail
